arxiv-1807-02261.title: On the Use of Context in Recommending Exception Handling Code Examples
arxiv-1807-02261.creator: Mohammad Masudur Rahman Chanchal K. Roy
arxiv-1807-02261.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Mohammad Masudur Rahman Chanchal K. Roy. Studies show that software developers often either misuse exception handling features or use them inefficiently, and such a practice may lead an undergoing software project to a fragile, insecure and non-robust application system. In this paper, we propose a context-aware code recommendation approach that recommends exception handling code examples from a number of popular open source code repositories hosted at GitHub.

arxiv-2002-05620.title: Gushel–Mukai varieties: intermediate Jacobians
arxiv-2002-05620.creator: Olivier Debarre, Alexander Kuznetsov
arxiv-2002-05620.description: Abstract Abstract. Let X be a Gushel–Mukai variety of dimension 3 or 5 . If A\subset\textstyle{\bigwedgeop\displaylimits\hskip-2.56073pt^{3}}\hskip 0.56905pt{V}_{6} is the Lagrangian subspace associated with X , we prove that the intermediate Jacobian of X is isomorphic to the Albanese variety of the canonical double covering of any of the two dual Eisenbud–Popescu–Walter surfaces Y^{\geq 2}_{A} and Y^{\geq 2}_{A^{\perp}} .

arxiv-2107-07576.title: Real-Time Face Recognition System for Remote Employee Tracking
arxiv-2107-07576.creator: Mohammad Sabik Irbaz, MD Abdullah Al Nasim, Refat E Ferdous
arxiv-2107-07576.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Mohammad Sabik Irbaz, MD Abdullah Al Nasim, Refat E Ferdous. During the COVID-19 pandemic, most of the human-to-human interactions have been stopped. To mitigate the spread of deadly coronavirus, many offices took the initiative so that the employees can work from home. But, tracking the employees and finding out if they are really performing what they were supposed to turn out to be a serious challenge for all the companies and organizations who are facilitating ”Work From Home”.

arxiv-2107-10514.title: The Differential Capacitance as a probe for the electric double layer structure and the electrolyte bulk composition
arxiv-2107-10514.creator: Peter Cats, René van Roij
arxiv-2107-10514.description: Abstract In this work we theoretically study the differential capacitance of an aqueous electrolyte in contact with a planar electrode, using classical Density Functional Theory, and show how this measurable quantity can be used as a probe to better understand the structure and composition of the electric double layer at play.

arxiv-2309-02849.title: QED effects in inclusive semi-leptonic 𝑩 B decays Preprint: CERN-TH-2023-145, MPP-2023-186
arxiv-2309-02849.creator: Dante Bigi, Marzia Bordone, Paolo Gambino, Ulrich Haisch, and Andrea Piccione
arxiv-2309-02849.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Dante Bigi, Marzia Bordone, Paolo Gambino, Ulrich Haisch, and Andrea Piccione. We analyse in detail the QED corrections to the total decay width and the moments of the electron energy spectrum of the inclusive semi-leptonic B → X c ​ e ​ ν B\to X_{c}e\nu decay. Our calculation includes short-distance electroweak corrections, the complete 𝒪 ⁡ ( α ) {\cal O}(\alpha) partonic terms and leading-logarithmic QED effects up to 𝒪 ⁡ ( Λ QCD 3 / m b 3 ) {\cal O}(\Lambda^{3}_{\rm QCD}/m_{b}^{3}) .

arxiv-2507-01853.creator: Samridhi Raj Sinha Rajvee Sheth, Abhishek Upperwal, Mayank Singh
arxiv-2507-01853.description: Abstract The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has intensified the need for evaluation frameworks that address the requirements of linguistically diverse regions, such as India, and go beyond English-centric benchmarks. We introduce Eka-Eval , a unified evaluation framework that integrates over 35+ benchmarks (including 10 Indic benchmarks) across nine major evaluation categories.

pmc-10534614.title: Dynamic Monitoring of Intracellular Tacrolimus and Mycophenolic Acid Therapy in Renal Transplant Recipients Using Magnetic Bead Extraction Combined with LC-MS/MS
pmc-10534614.creator: Huan Xu, Yingying Liu, Yinan Zhang, Xinhua Dai, Xueqiao Wang, Haojun Chen, Lin Yan, Xingxin Gong, Jiaxi Yue, Zhengli Wan, Jiwen Fan, Yangjuan Bai, Yao Luo, Yi Li, Yasumasa Ikeda
pmc-10534614.description: Background: Tacrolimus (TAC) and mycophenolic acid (MPA) are commonly used immunosuppressive therapies after renal transplant. Our objective was to quantify TAC and MPA concentrations in peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) using liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) and to evaluate and validate the performance of the methodology.

pmc-10648429.title: Development of a Scoring Tool for Australian Rural Food Retail Environments
pmc-10648429.creator: Tracy L Schumacher, Carissa A Alderton, Leanne J Brown, Susan Heaney, Laura Alston, Katherine Kent, Stephanie Louise Godrich, Dominik Szwajgier
pmc-10648429.description: Current tools scoring the healthiness of food retail outlets do not reflect outlets found in rural locations. This study aimed to adapt pre-existing Australian scoring tools to represent non-metropolitan areas. Rural nutrition experts were identified, and a modified Delphi technique was used to adapt two pre-existing, food-scoring tools in five iterative stages.

pmc-11484992.title: Absence of canonical mutations in pediatric essential thrombocytosis: a case series
pmc-11484992.creator: Jae Wook Lee, Suejung Jo, Jae Won Yoo, Seongkoo Kim, Nack-Gyun Chung, Bin Cho
pmc-11484992.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Essential thrombocytosis (ET) is a rare myeloproliferative disease in children, and there are few standard management guidelines. We herein report a case series of 10 pediatric patients with ET diagnosed at our institution over a period of 13 years. All patients fulfilled the World Health Organization diagnostic criteria for ET, and none harbored the canonical ET mutations JAK2 V617F, CALR, or MPL.

pmc-11533188.title: The usefulness of B-cell lymphoma-2 immunohistochemical stain in the differentiation between reactive atypia and dysplasia/carcinoma in the gallbladder
pmc-11533188.creator: Abdullah Saleh Alkhamiss
pmc-11533188.description: Objective:The differentiation between reactive atypical changes and dysplasia/carcinoma in the daily cases of cholecystectomies is a routine histopathological challenge. Up to our knowledge, no immunohistochemical marker can definitely differentiate between these two changes. Many promising markers have been proposed to be helpful tools in this situation. One of them is B-cell lymphoma-2 (BCL-2) immunohistochemical stain.

pmc-11633736.creator: Pengcheng Fu, Yongqing Zhang, Siming Wang, Xin Ye, Yunhong Wu, Mengfei Yu, Shiyao Zhu, Hyeon Jeong Lee, Delong Zhang

While stimulated Raman imaging has found successes in deciphering biological machinery, many vibrational modes are Raman inactive or weak, limiting the broader impact of the technique.

pmc-11689441.title: XPRIZE HEALTHSPAN: A PATH TO ACCELERATE TRANSLATIONAL GEROSCIENCE
pmc-11689441.creator: Jamie Justice
pmc-11689441.description: By targeting biological aging pathways with a single or combination of therapeutic treatments, it may be possible to restore function lost to age-related degradation of multiple organ systems. Interventions targeting aging pathways are being translated to humans, yet public perception, poor alignment and testing guidelines, and unclear regulatory and commercial pathways are barriers to clinical translation.

pmc-12413524.title: A prospective case–control study: Analysis of the analgesic effect of acetaminophen–mannitol injection after endoscopic lumbar discectomy
pmc-12413524.creator: Jie-Bin Huang, Yin-Feng Guo, Cheng-Zhao Li, Wei-Xiong Chen, Bai-Yong Zhu, Yu Lei, Wei-Dong Jiao, Li-Bin Zheng, Hou-Jun Xue

pmc-12464694.title: Coronary stenting after aortic root replacement
pmc-12464694.creator: Alexey Viktorovich Kudrinskiy, Artem Vladimirovich Snitsar, Marat Amayakovich Sedgaryan, Maxim Valentinovich Patlachuk
pmc-12464694.description: We describe a case of severe coronary artery stenosis in a 29-year-old male 1 month after aortic root replacement (ARR). The patient presented with exertional chest pain that progressed to prolonged resting angina and ventricular arrhythmia. Electrocardiography showed ischemic changes suggestive of left coronary artery involvement, and multislice computed tomography angiography confirmed subtotal stenosis at the left main (LM) bifurcation.

pmc-12568495.title: IL-5, IL-31 and systemic immune-inflammation index as biomarkers predicting severity and progression in bullous pemphigoid
pmc-12568495.creator: Yanyu Zhang, Xia Liu, Lili Hou, Yan Zhao, Jiaxuan Hao, Na Zhang, Jing Tian, Xiaoqing Li, Zhiyu Liu, Hongwei Zhou, Chunyang Xu, Yuan Ren, Haizhou Zhou
pmc-12568495.description: IntroductionInflammatory mechanisms assume a pivotal role in bullous pemphigoid (BP). IL-31, IL-5, and the systemic immunoinflammatory index (SII) are emerging markers of inflammatory activity, but their associations with BP severity remain unclear. This investigation sought to investigate the correlation of the three aforementioned indicators with BP disease severity to determine their potential application in predicting BP severity.

pmc-12688492.title: Comparison of uniportal and three-portal video-assisted thoracoscopic thymectomy for thymoma: a propensity score-matched study
pmc-12688492.creator: Zipu Yu, Guofei Zhang, Gang Shen
pmc-12688492.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundMinimally invasive thymectomy (MIT) is a surgical approach to thymectomy. To investigate the efficacy of the MIT, a retrospective comparison for perioperative outcomes of patients was conducted between uniportal and three-portal video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (UP-VATS and TP-VATS) thymectomy.MethodsA detailed database search identified 135 patients treated with UP-VATS thymectomy technique and 228 patients treated via TP-VATS thymectomy technique between January 2013 and December 2022 from the same surgeon and medical team.

pmc-12722338.title: Lasting Effects of Different Scaled Mass Mortality Events on Soil Microbial Communities
pmc-12722338.creator: Abby K. Jones, Heather R. Jordan, Carter L. Wolff, Marcus A. Lashley, Brandon T. Barton
pmc-12722338.description: Death is a natural process present in all ecosystems; however, mass mortality events are instances of larger than average numbers of animals dying in a relatively short period of time. These events are increasing in frequency and magnitude, and the effects of mass mortalities — especially their long-term effects — are understudied.

pmc-13147996.title: Bioproduction of ∼10 knt single-stranded DNA for constructing large DNA origami structures
pmc-13147996.creator: Meiling Lu, Xiwei Wang, Baohong He, Jingyan Zhang, Youqing Cu, Jinjing Che, Nan Liu, Zengming Wang, Hui Zhang, Liang Xu, Xuili Gao, Aiping Zheng
pmc-13147996.description: DNA origami structures based on M13 scaffolds have limitations in terms of functional integration and size expansion. Therefore, preparing long single-stranded DNA (ssDNA) and stably synthesizing large DNA origami structures are key challenges.

uslaw-usc-t12-s1769.title: 12 U.S.C. § 1769 — Separability; right to alter, amend, or repeal chapter
uslaw-usc-t12-s1769.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s1769.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 14 (Federal Credit Unions); Subchapter I (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) If any provision of this chapter, or the application thereof to any person or circumstance, is held invalid, the remainder of the chapter, and the application of such provision to other persons or circumstances, shall not be affected thereby.
